thread:
nina: Heads-up: we're planning a base-image rebuild for runtime-minimal (to remove setuid deps) and switch to an ephemeral KMS fetch model (short-lived service tokens). Need input on RBAC, audit trail, and how to roll this out without breaking long-running jobs.

omar: Ephemeral tokens sound good. Do we mean the init process will fetch a wrapped secret and then exchange for a short-lived token from KMS/STS? Or are we minting workload identity tokens from the metadata service?

nina: The plan is: build-time we cosign and attest images; at runtime the init helper hits the platform token-exchange endpoint (svc-identity) which calls KMS to unwrap and returns a short TTL token tied to the pod identity. No permanent KMS key access in the container.

lucas: That reduces blast radius. For RBAC we need: 1) build pipeline has cosign signer key access, 2) platform token-exchange service needs KMS decrypt/unwrapping permission, and 3) pods only get ephemeral tokens (no key permissions).

hannah: Audit logging request from SecOps: every unwrap/token-issue must produce an immutable audit event with {event: "unwrap", image_digest, pod_sid, issuer, key_id}. Want both tenant logs and a secured copy in GCS for 7 years. Who owns retention?

secops-bot: [policy] Retention policy must be reviewed. Current default is 90 days for stdout logs. Long-term archive requires request to security-compliance for SLA+budget. Ticket: SEC-1029.

omar: For implementation details: add a mandatory image attestation claim (in the cosign bundle) that includes a minimal seccomp profile and a checksum of any helper binaries. The token-exchange service should verify the attestation before issuing tokens.

nina: Good. Also want a graceful fallback for long-running jobs that can't be restarted during rollout. Suggest: keep the old base image in parallel for 30 days and only migrate batch/short-lived workloads first. For stateful long jobs, plan maintenance windows.

lucas: On incident response: add an emergency revoke endpoint that invalidates outstanding ephemeral tokens tied to a key rotation. Also publish a playbook: steps to rotate KMS keys, revoke tokens, and trigger cluster rollouts.

hannah: Logging schema proposed: stdout line on successful token mint: {"event":"token_mint","image":"sha256:...","pod":"ns/pod","issuer":"svc-identity","key":"projects/.../cryptoKeys/...","ttl_s":"300"}. On failure include error_code and stacktrace id.

secops-bot: [compliance] Ensure logs do not contain plaintext secrets. Any correlation id acceptable. Also mask any user identifiers according to PII policy.

omar: CI gates: 1) Attestation present and validates against runtime policy, 2) Static analysis of the helper (gosec + fuzzing harness), 3) Seccomp profile validated against allowed syscall list. Build-bot should fail the promotion if any gate fails.

build-bot: [ci] stub: added gates in the staging pipeline. See PR #infra/4521.

nina: One subtlety: how do we handle image pulling and admission if a node lacks the token-exchange network access (air-gapped clusters)? For private deploys we need an on-prem token-exchange agent or kube-admission that runs locally.

lucas: For private clusters, run an agent that has KMS access inside the VPC (or an HSM proxy). Document difference in README. Also create a fallback where the init helper can optionally use a mounted secret if explicitly allowed by the platform admin (but then increased audit scrutiny).

hannah: Rotation plan: keys rotate monthly. Make sure cached credentials in running pods have TTL < rotation interval and that the token-exchange validates key version. Emit a "key_rotate" event to logs so SecOps can map which pods might need reprovision.

omar: Testing: run a canary where 10% of pods use the new image+token flow for 48h, run KMS outage simulation and key rotation simulation. Add probing that ensures 401/403 anomalies are surfaced as PagerDuty alerts.

nina: Access requests: platform team needs permission to list cosign attestations and to read the signing public key, not the private signer. Build/signer team retains signer private key in KMS with strict ACL.

lucas: Also add image provenance check into the admission controller: deny if image is unsigned or attestation missing. Provide an allowlist for internal debug images.

hannah: For forensic needs, include an immutable index entry with attestation bundle + mint log for every token issuance stored in secure storage. That makes post-incident reconstruction possible.

secops-bot: [notice] Recommended schema changes accepted. Please attach retention escalation to SEC-1029.

nina: OK next steps: 1) lucas to draft RBAC/IAM policy and emergency revoke API; 2) hannah to finalize logging schema and retention ask; 3) omar to update CI gates and static analysis checklist; 4) i'll schedule canary for next Thursday. I'll post links when ready.

lucas: Will attach a sample IAM policy snippet in the canary doc.

nina: Thanks everyone. If you want to run drills, ping me and i'll reserve a canary slot. :white_check_mark:
